scope: Diagnostics only; no UI automation, app/account actions, arbitrary invocation, or device file access.

transport.host: Apple Mobile Device Service via localhost:27015 on Windows
transport.frames: 4-byte big-endian JSON byte length followed by UTF-8 JSON; one request/response per USB connection

activation: Explicit first opt-in; enabled preference persists. Foreground listener automatically resumes after background or relaunch, until manually disabled.

authentication.code: 8 random UUID hexadecimal characters shown only in app UI
authentication.token: Independent 32-hex credential per saved PC, issued on one-time pairing
authentication.stop_on: Background pauses listener; disable stops automatic resumption; forget saved computers revokes all tokens.
authentication.persisted_in_app: Private keychain item, WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly; default signer access group; maximum 8 computers.
authentication.pc_storage: Windows current-user DPAPI plus per-iPhone UDID/client identity. No credentials in reports/stdout/argv.

operations.capture-stop: Stop native expensive capture and probe logging; retain evidence and normal requests/caches/decisions
operations.probe: Existing current-video branding service diagnostic only

bounds.recording: Default continuous until Ctrl+C; optional finite positive duration.

lifecycle: Foreground opt-in listener, no session expiry, saved credentials independent of listener generation. Background shutdown interrupts workers; foreground retries listener binding and re-arms owned capture without clearing evidence. Revoked tokens rechecked on main before snapshots or commands. Collector pins UDID, rediscovers USB IDs, retries availability/report failures indefinitely. Socket/main-queue fault bounds retained to keep the app responsive. Ambiguous capture-start/probe delivery is not replayed automatically.
reports: Compressed complete JSON transport envelope plus compact checkpoint summary saved outside IPA output. Exclusive filenames prevent replacement of older reports.
completion: Prior 0.3.41 USB report confirmed delivery. Latest report: 179 rejected bindings, 116 live_card_identity_field_absent, no service jobs. User reports watch controls work. Apple compilation and production packaging; no tests. 0.3.42 persistent pairing/reconnect needs upgraded IPA, one-time pair and device confirmation.
